📋 QUICK REFERENCE
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

📁 FILES CREATED:
   • .github/workflows/automation.yml ........... Main workflow file
   • .github/QUICK_START.md ................... 5-minute setup guide
   • .github/GITHUB_ACTIONS_SETUP.md .......... Detailed configuration
   • .github/TROUBLESHOOTING.md .............. FAQ & common issues
   • .github/IMPLEMENTATION_SUMMARY.md ........ Complete overview
   • .github/CHECKLIST.md .................... Verification checklist
   • .github/REFERENCE_CARD.txt .............. This file

🎯 WHAT HAPPENS AUTOMATICALLY:
   1. Code pushed to main branch → Workflow triggers
   2. Java 17 + Temurin installed
   3. Maven dependencies cached
   4. Code compiled: mvn clean compile
   5. Tests executed: mvn test
   6. OPENAI_API_KEY available to Java
   7. Test reports uploaded as artifacts
   8. Allure report generated
   9. Results available for download

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

🚀 DEPLOYMENT (Copy & Paste Ready)
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Step 1: Commit Workflow
───────────────────────
git add .github/
git commit -m "Add GitHub Actions CI/CD workflow"
git push origin main

Step 2: Configure Secret on GitHub
───────────────────────────────────
1. Go to: GitHub → Your Repo → Settings
2. Click: Secrets and variables → Actions
3. New secret:
   Name: OPENAI_API_KEY
   Value: your_api_key_here
4. Save

Step 3: Verify in GitHub Actions
─────────────────────────────────
1. Go to: Actions tab
2. Look for: "SentinelQA Test Automation"
3. Click "Run workflow" to trigger manually

Step 4: Download Results
────────────────────────
1. Click workflow run
2. Scroll to "Artifacts" section
3. Download: test-reports-and-logs-*
4. Download: allure-report-*

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

🔐 SECURITY ESSENTIALS
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Store in GitHub Secret:
   ✓ OPENAI_API_KEY
   ✓ Any API keys, tokens, passwords
   ✓ Database credentials
   ✓ Authentication headers

Never in Code:
   ✗ Hardcoded secrets
   ✗ API keys in java files
   ✗ Credentials in config.properties
   ✗ Passwords in test code

Access in Java Code:
   String key = System.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY");

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

🔄 WORKFLOW TRIGGERS
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Automatic Triggers:
   • Push to main branch
   • Pull request to main
   • (Optional) Scheduled: cron '0 2 * * *'

Manual Trigger:
   1. GitHub → Actions tab
   2. SentinelQA Test Automation
   3. Run workflow → Run workflow

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

⚡ WORKFLOW STEPS (In Order)
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

 1. Checkout Repository ................ Clone your code
 2. Set up Java 17 (Temurin) .......... Install Java runtime
 3. Cache Maven Dependencies .......... Speed up builds (50-70% faster)
 4. Configure Environment Variables ... Set OPENAI_API_KEY
 5. Display Java & Maven Versions .... Diagnostic info
 6. Clean and Compile Project ........ Validate code
 7. Run Tests ......................... Execute TestNG tests
 8. Upload Test Reports .............. Save artifacts
 9. Generate Allure Report ........... Create dashboard
10. Upload Allure Report ............. Save for viewing
11. Generate Workflow Summary ........ Display results

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

📊 ARTIFACTS UPLOADED
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Downloaded Automatically:
   ✓ test-output/
   ✓ reports/
   ✓ target/surefire-reports/
   ✓ allure-results/
   ✓ target/allure-report/

Retention: 30 days

Location: GitHub Actions → Run → Artifacts section

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

⏱️  EXPECTED PERFORMANCE
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

First Run (No Cache):
   • Total time: ~3-5 minutes
   • Checkout: ~5 seconds
   • Java setup: ~15 seconds
   • Maven cache creation: ~2 minutes
   • Compilation: ~30 seconds
   • Tests: ~60-120 seconds

Subsequent Runs (With Cache):
   • Total time: ~2-3 minutes
   • Cache hit: ~5 seconds (saves ~2 minutes)
   • Compilation: ~30 seconds
   • Tests: ~60-120 seconds

Impact of Changes:
   • Code change: Uses cache (~2-3 min)
   • pom.xml change: Rebuilds cache (~3-5 min)

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

🆘 QUICK TROUBLESHOOTING
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Problem: Workflow not running
Solution: Push workflow file to main first (wait 1-2 minutes)

Problem: API key not accessible
Solution: Verify OPENAI_API_KEY secret in GitHub Settings

Problem: Tests fail locally but pass in CI
Solution: Check environment variables and config files

Problem: Artifacts not uploading
Solution: Ensure if: always() is on upload step

Problem: Java version mismatch
Solution: Verify pom.xml and workflow both say Java 17

📖 For detailed help: Read .github/TROUBLESHOOTING.md

🔗 USEFUL COMMANDS
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

View Workflow File:
   cat .github/workflows/automation.yml

Run Tests Locally:
   mvn clean test

Run Tests with API Key:
   export OPENAI_API_KEY=your_key
   mvn test

View Git Status:
   git status

Push to GitHub:
   git push origin main

Check Remote URL:
   git remote -v
